title: Cryptographic Differential Analysis: Information Leakage From Steering On vs Off

original_idea.body: Treat steering on/off as a secret bit and quantify how reliably an external observer detects it from outputs. Black-box, no training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain to a deceptive-alignment-adjacent threat, but the external-detectability-to-catastrophe step has a gap (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Compute output-distribution divergences steered vs unsteered; clear methodology, black-box, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (leakage budget per concept), few dependencies (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly black-box model-organism-style study on open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Steering detectability published from within; black-box external-leakage framing may add modest novelty.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Internal detectability is published; the external black-box leakage angle may be open.
